title: 故障转移选主规则：priority -> offset -> runid
expected_output:
=== 故障转移选主规则模拟 ===
候选从节点:
  r1 priority=100 offset=5000 runid=zzz
  r2 priority=100 offset=8000 runid=aaa
  r3 priority=50 offset=6000 runid=mmm
选主规则: replica-priority 最小 -> 复制 offset 最大 -> runid 字典序最小
先比 priority: r3=50 最小 -> 直接当选 (offset/runid 不再参与比较)
当选新主 = r3 (priority=50, offset=6000)
code:
print("=== 故障转移选主规则模拟 ===")
replicas = [
    {"id": "r1", "priority": 100, "offset": 5000, "runid": "zzz"},
    {"id": "r2", "priority": 100, "offset": 8000, "runid": "aaa"},
    {"id": "r3", "priority": 50,  "offset": 6000, "runid": "mmm"},
]
print("候选从节点:")
for r in replicas:
    print("  %s priority=%d offset=%d runid=%s" % (r["id"], r["priority"], r["offset"], r["runid"]))
print("选主规则: replica-priority 最小 -> 复制 offset 最大 -> runid 字典序最小")
best = min(replicas, key=lambda r: (r["priority"], -r["offset"], r["runid"]))
print("先比 priority: r3=50 最小 -> 直接当选 (offset/runid 不再参与比较)")
print("当选新主 =", best["id"], "(priority=%d, offset=%d)" % (best["priority"], best["offset"]))
